title: Active Directory Explained: The Tree, the Trusts, and Why Attackers Love It

preconditions: A HackTheBox machine/challenge provides a deployed target (VM/network/web app) with a defined goal (user and/or root flag), but the box name alone does not indicate a specific vulnerability class

process.action: Deploy/connect to the target (VPN) and run initial reconnaissance to enumerate open services and technologies
process.expected_observation: List of open ports/services and their versions

process.action: Enumerate each discovered service for further attack surface (web directories, SMB shares, exposed credentials)
process.expected_observation: Additional endpoints, shares, or files discovered

process.action: Identify and exploit the intended initial-access vulnerability for the target software/version to obtain the user flag
process.expected_observation: Initial foothold (shell or credential access) obtained and user flag retrieved

process.action: Enumerate the local system for privilege escalation vectors (misconfigurations, SUID binaries, vulnerable services, cron jobs)
process.expected_observation: A viable privilege escalation path identified

process.action: Execute the privilege escalation path and retrieve the root/administrator flag

impact: N/A - educational lab context; demonstrates the general initial-access-to-privilege-escalation kill chain
